  --real $L/official-train.txt:.15 --real $L/hard-owner.txt:.05 --real $L/hard-owner2.txt:.10 --real $L/hard-owner3.txt:.08 \
  --real $L/hard-owner4.txt:.16 --real $L/nulls-full-v1.txt:.12 --real $L/hard-owner7.txt:.10 --real $L/rawtrain.txt:.15 --real $L/hard-owner10.txt:.08 --real $L/hard-owner11.txt:.08 --real $L/hard-owner12.txt:.20 --real $L/hard-owner13.txt:.08 --real $L/hard-owner14.txt:.10 --real $L/hard-owner15.txt:.06 --real $L/hard-owner16.txt:.10 --real $L/hard-owner17.txt:.08 --real $L/hard-owner18.txt:.10 --real $L/hard-owner20.txt:.10 --real $L/hard-owner21.txt:.15 --real $L/hard-owner22.txt:.20 --real $L/hard-owner22b.txt:.20 --real $L/hard-owner22n.txt:.10 --real $L/hard-owner23.txt:.15 --real $L/hard-owner24.txt:.15 --real $L/hard-owner25.txt:.20 --real $L/katacr-part2-bal2.txt:.05 \
